method: Protect every alpha>5 pixel plus 16px Chebyshev-distance margin (33x33 maximum filter). Remove only alpha1..5 pixels beyond that margin. Zero RGB only where final alpha=0. No threshold cutting of visible body, no crop, no resize.
qa_note: Local alpha compositing; blue is present only in the QA PNG, not in the Sprite. Large colorful source RGB regions with alpha=0 are not a visible aura.

visual_review.notes: Viewed original and clean composites. The large colorful source preview aura is invisible when actual alpha is applied; the character stack and its edges match between both images.
